richiami.difetto: It is possible that due to issues with the bonding adhesive between the glass and the metal frame  the bonding adhesive can start to fail.  This condition is gradual and is identified by metal corrosion of the frame wind noise vibrations visual separation and water leaks.  If this condition persists and is not rectified it is possible that the glass sunroof can detach from the vehicle.
richiami.rimedio: Identification of the affected vehicles and replacement of the glass/metal frame panel.

richiami.difetto: The material composition of certain stainless steel burner tubes are not within the correct specification.  This can cause the burner tubes to deteriorate at an accelerated rate and can possibly fail.  In extreme cases this could cause a fire or allow exhaust fumes to enter the vehicle.  To date there have been no incidents of property damage or personal injury.
richiami.rimedio: Webasto has initiated a recall of all 11 potentially affected units and will replace all affected burner tubes.
richiami.titolo: CERTAIN BURNER TUBES MAY NOT BE MANUFACTURED TO THE CORRECT SPECIFICATION
